e **Authenticator-app sign-in (TOTP)** replaced the email-code idea (no mail service needed): Me → Settings → **Authenticator app** (`renderAuth`, signed-in Google users only) → `POST /api/totp/setup` gives a secret + `otpauth://` URI, shown as a QR code (qrcode-generator 1.4.4, loaded on demand from jsDelivr, cdnjs fallback; the key is shown too, with Copy) → the user confirms with a 6-digit code (`POST /api/totp/confirm`) → `wm:totp:<sub>`; Turn off = `DELETE /api/totp`.
